# Scope and reproducibility

This revised notebook implements the **required** parts of the Fall 2026 methylation homework, based on `Fa26 Methylation Homework.pdf` and `Methylation_Data_DEMO.Rmd`. The comparison is **Metastatic minus Primary solid Tumor**, as labeled in the methylation `definition` metadata. These are specimen labels; primary tumors are **not** guaranteed to be from patients who never developed metastases. The analysis is observational and does not establish causality. The optional UCSC/literature extra credit is documented at the end, but requires manual browser evidence and is not claimed as completed.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, warning=TRUE, message=TRUE)
analysis_dir <- "/home1/puyuanli/490_cluster/analysis_data"
output_dir <- "/home1/puyuanli/490_cluster/week08_methylation"
stopifnot(dir.exists(analysis_dir))
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings=FALSE, recursive=TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir=analysis_dir)
```

## Packages and input checks

```{r packages}
needed <- c("TCGAbiolinks", "SummarizedExperiment", "limma", "DESeq2", "ggplot2")
missing <- needed[!vapply(needed, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly=TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Install missing packages before proceeding: ", paste(missing, collapse=", "), ". Use BiocManager::install() for Bioconductor packages.")
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(limma)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Prepare only the required methylation sample types

The instructor requests **Metastatic** and **Primary solid Tumor** specimens, not every TCGA-BRCA specimen. This query restricts the GDC file manifest to GDC sample types **Metastatic** and **Primary Tumor** before downloading. The labels in `colData(methylation450)$definition` remain the final authority for the analysis. The query can still contain many primary-tumor files: the assignment does not authorize arbitrarily selecting a small subset of patients.

**Important:** The previous broad download placed files under `analysis_data/TCGA-BRCA/`, not necessarily under `analysis_data/GDCdata/`. Keep that directory intact. If you already have a prepared RDS, the following setup will reuse it. If not, run the next query/download chunk once, then run preparation. Do not run a second simultaneous download.

```{r methylation-query}
meth_rds <- file.path(analysis_dir, "brca_methylation450_se.rds")
if (file.exists(meth_rds)) {
  cat("Existing prepared methylation object found; skipping query/download.\n")
} else {
  meth_query <- GDCquery(
    project = "TCGA-BRCA",
    data.category = "DNA Methylation",
    data.type = "Methylation Beta Value",
    platform = "Illumina Human Methylation 450",
    data.format = "Dataframe",
    sample.type = c("Primary Tumor", "Metastatic")
  )
  manifest <- getResults(meth_query)
  cat("Requested files after sample-type restriction:", nrow(manifest), "\n")
  if ("sample_type" %in% names(manifest)) print(table(manifest$sample_type, useNA="ifany"))
  stopifnot(nrow(manifest) > 0)
}
```

```{r methylation-download, eval=FALSE}
# RUN MANUALLY ONLY IF the methylation RDS does not exist and the
# RStudio Console is not already running a GDCdownload operation.
# Existing correctly downloaded files in analysis_dir will be reused.
#GDCdownload(meth_query, directory=analysis_dir, method="api", files.per.chunk=20)
```

```{r methylation-prepare}
if (!file.exists(meth_rds)) {
  if (!exists("meth_query")) stop("No prepared RDS and no query: run methylation-query first.")
  methylation450 <- GDCprepare(meth_query, directory=analysis_dir)
  saveRDS(methylation450, meth_rds)
  cat("Saved prepared object:", meth_rds, "\n")
} else {
  methylation450 <- readRDS(meth_rds)
}
stopifnot(inherits(methylation450, "SummarizedExperiment"))
cat("Methylation object dimensions:", paste(dim(methylation450),collapse=" x "), "\n")
cat("Assays:", paste(assayNames(methylation450),collapse=", "), "\n")
```

## Select the two required specimen groups

```{r methylation-groups}
meth_meta <- as.data.frame(colData(methylation450))
stopifnot("definition" %in% names(meth_meta))
print(table(meth_meta$definition, useNA="ifany"))
keep_m <- !is.na(meth_meta$definition) & meth_meta$definition %in% c("Metastatic", "Primary solid Tumor")
meth_meta <- meth_meta[keep_m,,drop=FALSE]
meth_meta$group <- factor(meth_meta$definition, levels=c("Primary solid Tumor","Metastatic"))
stopifnot(all(table(meth_meta$group)>=2L))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(meth_meta),colnames(methylation450)[keep_m]))
print(table(meth_meta$group))
```

## Naive differential methylation (limma, CpG-level)

The methylation response is a **logit2-transformed beta value (M-value)**, not a gene-expression log2 fold change. Values of exactly 0 or 1 are clipped to a small epsilon solely to avoid infinities. The estimated group coefficient is the difference in mean M-value between metastatic and primary specimens. The homework's 0.05 adjusted-p-value and absolute-effect-size threshold of 1 are used for the volcano plot, with the caveat that an M-value difference is not a conventional fold change.

```{r methylation-limma}
# Avoid converting the full assay into a large data.frame; work on a matrix.
n_assays <- length(SummarizedExperiment::assays(methylation450))
stopifnot(n_assays == 1L)
assay_name <- 1L
beta_all <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(
  methylation450, i=assay_name, withDimnames=TRUE
)
beta <- as.matrix(beta_all[,keep_m,drop=FALSE])
stopifnot(identical(colnames(beta),rownames(meth_meta)))
stopifnot(is.numeric(beta), all(beta[is.finite(beta)]>=0 & beta[is.finite(beta)]<=1))
# Allow some missing observations, but require >=2 observed values per group per CpG.
grp <- meth_meta$group
valid <- rowSums(is.finite(beta[,grp=="Primary solid Tumor",drop=FALSE]))>=2 &
         rowSums(is.finite(beta[,grp=="Metastatic",drop=FALSE]))>=2
beta <- beta[valid,,drop=FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(beta)>0)
eps <- 1e-6
beta_clip <- pmin(pmax(beta,eps),1-eps)
mval <- log2(beta_clip/(1-beta_clip))
mval[!is.finite(beta)] <- NA_real_
rm(beta_clip, beta_all)
gc(verbose=FALSE)
mm <- model.matrix(~group, data=meth_meta)
stopifnot(qr(mm)$rank==ncol(mm))
fit <- eBayes(lmFit(mval,mm))
coef_name <- grep("^groupMetastatic$",colnames(mm),value=TRUE)
stopifnot(length(coef_name)==1)
limma_table <- topTable(fit,coef=coef_name,number=Inf,sort.by="none",adjust.method="BH")
limma_table$probe_id <- rownames(limma_table)
limma_table$delta_beta <- rowMeans(beta[,grp=="Metastatic",drop=FALSE],na.rm=TRUE)-
                          rowMeans(beta[,grp=="Primary solid Tumor",drop=FALSE],na.rm=TRUE)
# Gene annotations come from the same SE row ranges, keyed by probe ID.
probe_annotations <- as.data.frame(rowData(methylation450))
cat("Annotation columns:",paste(names(probe_annotations),collapse=", "),"\n")
if (!"gene" %in% names(probe_annotations)) stop("The methylation object lacks a gene annotation column. Inspect names(rowData(methylation450)) and the instructor demo before proceeding.")
probe_annotations$probe_id <- rownames(methylation450)
idx <- match(limma_table$probe_id,probe_annotations$probe_id)
stopifnot(!anyNA(idx))
limma_table$gene_name <- as.character(probe_annotations$gene[idx])
# Do not misattribute probes mapped to multiple genes.
limma_table$gene_name[grepl("[;,]",limma_table$gene_name)] <- NA_character_
limma_table$gene_name[!nzchar(trimws(ifelse(is.na(limma_table$gene_name),"",limma_table$gene_name)))] <- NA_character_
limma_table$significant <- !is.na(limma_table$adj.P.Val) & limma_table$adj.P.Val<0.05 & abs(limma_table$logFC)>=1
cat("Tested CpG sites:",nrow(limma_table),"\n")
cat("Significant CpGs (BH FDR<0.05, |delta M|>=1):",sum(limma_table$significant),"\n")
write.csv(limma_table,file.path(analysis_dir,"brca_methylation_metastatic_vs_primary_limma.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r methylation-volcano, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
volc <- limma_table
volc$neglog10FDR <- -log10(pmax(volc$adj.P.Val,.Machine$double.xmin))
volc$category <- ifelse(volc$significant & volc$logFC>0,"Hyper in metastatic",
                        ifelse(volc$significant & volc$logFC<0,"Hypo in metastatic","Not significant"))
p1 <- ggplot(volc,aes(logFC,neglog10FDR,color=category))+
  geom_point(alpha=.45,size=.55,na.rm=TRUE)+
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-1,1),linetype="dashed")+
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(.05),linetype="dashed")+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Hyper in metastatic"="#B2182B","Hypo in metastatic"="#2166AC","Not significant"="grey70"))+
  labs(title="TCGA-BRCA CpG methylation: metastatic vs primary",
       subtitle="Naive limma model; BH FDR < 0.05 and absolute delta M >= 1",
       x="Metastatic minus primary: difference in M-value",y="-log10(BH-adjusted p-value)",color=NULL)+
  theme_bw()
print(p1)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"brca_methylation_volcano.png"),p1,width=9,height=6,dpi=180)
```

### Part 1 interpretation (automatically populated after execution)

```{r part1-interpretation, results='asis'}
n_up <- sum(limma_table$significant & limma_table$logFC>0)
n_down <- sum(limma_table$significant & limma_table$logFC<0)
cat(sprintf("Across the two TCGA-BRCA specimen categories, the CpG-level model identified **%s CpG sites with higher methylation M-values in metastatic specimens** and **%s with lower M-values**, using BH-adjusted p < 0.05 and an absolute M-value difference of at least 1. ",format(n_up,big.mark=","),format(n_down,big.mark=",")))
cat("These associations indicate that some measured CpG sites differ between the sampled groups, but the plot alone does not show that the differences caused metastasis. ")
cat("In particular, the 'Primary solid Tumor' label does not establish that a patient never developed metastatic disease, and sampling site, tumor purity, clinical confounding, and unequal group sizes can affect the comparison. ")
cat("The model is unadjusted, so its results should be treated as exploratory rather than patient-level causal or prognostic conclusions.\n")
```

# Part 2 — Differential RNA expression and gene intersection

**Do not reuse the Week 7 tumor-versus-normal DESeq results as if they were metastatic-versus-primary.** We refit using RNA counts from Week 7 and **methylation sample metadata** for group assignment. Only exact TCGA sample-level matches (first 16 barcode characters, including sample type and vial) are accepted. If no RNA samples represent both groups, the analysis must stop rather than manufacture a comparison.

```{r rna-inputs}
rna_counts_path <- file.path(analysis_dir,"brca_rna_count_data.csv")
rna_genes_path <- file.path(analysis_dir,"brca_rna_gene_data.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(rna_counts_path),file.exists(rna_genes_path))
rna_counts <- read.csv(rna_counts_path,row.names=1,check.names=FALSE)
rna_genes <- read.csv(rna_genes_path,check.names=FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("gene_id","gene_name") %in% names(rna_genes)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(rna_counts)))
# TCGA sample-level identifiers: TCGA-XX-XXXX-01A (16 chars).
sample_key <- function(x) substr(as.character(x),1,16)
meth_key <- sample_key(rownames(meth_meta))
stopifnot(all(grepl("^TCGA-",meth_key)))
rna_key <- sample_key(colnames(rna_counts))
stopifnot(all(grepl("^TCGA-",rna_key)))
# Disallow ambiguous methylation annotations or duplicate RNA aliquots for same sample.
unique_m <- !duplicated(meth_key) & !duplicated(meth_key,fromLast=TRUE)
unique_r <- !duplicated(rna_key) & !duplicated(rna_key,fromLast=TRUE)
idx_m <- match(rna_key,meth_key)
matched <- !is.na(idx_m) & unique_r & unique_m[pmax(idx_m,1)]
cat("Unambiguous sample-level RNA/methylation matches:",sum(matched),"\n")
matched_counts <- as.matrix(rna_counts[,matched,drop=FALSE])
if (!any(matched)) stop("No unambiguous exact 16-character sample matches between RNA and methylation. A valid metastatic-versus-primary DESeq2 model cannot be inferred from the Week 7 tumor/normal results. Consult the TA about the intended sample matching strategy.")
matched_meta <- meth_meta[idx_m[matched],,drop=FALSE]
rownames(matched_meta) <- colnames(matched_counts)
stopifnot(identical(colnames(matched_counts),rownames(matched_meta)))
print(table(matched_meta$group))
if (any(table(matched_meta$group)<2)) stop("Cannot fit a metastatic-versus-primary RNA model: fewer than two matched RNA samples in at least one group. Do not substitute Week 7 tumor/normal results. Consult the TA about the intended RNA matching strategy.")
stopifnot(all(is.finite(matched_counts)),all(matched_counts>=0),all(matched_counts==round(matched_counts)))
```

```{r rna-deseq, cache=TRUE}
# Required expression filter: total raw count >=20 across retained RNA samples.
matched_counts <- matched_counts[rowSums(matched_counts)>=20,,drop=FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(matched_counts)>0)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=round(matched_counts),colData=matched_meta,design=~group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
de_results <- as.data.frame(results(dds,contrast=c("group","Metastatic","Primary solid Tumor")))
de_results$gene_id <- rownames(de_results)
gene_idx <- match(de_results$gene_id,as.character(rna_genes$gene_id))
if (anyNA(gene_idx)) {
  strip_version <- function(x) sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", as.character(x))
  ref_ids <- strip_version(rna_genes$gene_id)
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ref_ids))
  gene_idx <- match(strip_version(de_results$gene_id),ref_ids)
}
stopifnot(!anyNA(gene_idx))
de_results$gene_name <- as.character(rna_genes$gene_name[gene_idx])
write.csv(de_results,file.path(analysis_dir,"brca_metastatic_vs_primary_DESeq2.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
saveRDS(dds,file.path(analysis_dir,"brca_metastatic_vs_primary_dds.rds"))
cat("Genes tested:",nrow(de_results),"\n")
print(summary(results(dds,contrast=c("group","Metastatic","Primary solid Tumor"))))
```

## Choose a hypermethylated, downregulated gene

For gene selection, **downregulated** means RNA log2FC <= -1 and RNA BH FDR < 0.05; **hypermethylated** means CpG delta M >= 1 and CpG BH FDR < 0.05. These are the assignment's statistical thresholds, applied to the correct direction of each comparison. Because multiple CpGs can map to one gene, this is a candidate-generation step, not proof of promoter methylation or transcriptional silencing.

```{r intersect-genes}
downregulated <- unique(de_results$gene_name[!is.na(de_results$padj) & de_results$padj<.05 & de_results$log2FoldChange<=-1])
hypermethylated <- unique(limma_table$gene_name[
  !is.na(limma_table$gene_name) &
  !is.na(limma_table$adj.P.Val) &
  is.finite(limma_table$logFC) &
  limma_table$adj.P.Val < 0.05 &
  limma_table$logFC > 0
])
interest_genes <- sort(intersect(downregulated,hypermethylated))
cat("Downregulated gene names:",length(downregulated),"\n")
cat("Hypermethylated-associated gene names:",length(hypermethylated),"\n")
cat("Intersected candidates:",length(interest_genes),"\n")
print(head(interest_genes,25))
if (!length(interest_genes)) stop("No gene passes both criteria; cannot legitimately select a gene for Part 2. Review sample matching and discuss with TA before changing thresholds.")
# Deterministic candidate: strongest RNA adjusted p-value among intersected names.
candidates <- de_results[
  de_results$gene_name %in% interest_genes &
  !is.na(de_results$padj) &
  is.finite(de_results$log2FoldChange) &
  de_results$padj < 0.05 &
  de_results$log2FoldChange <= -1,
  , drop=FALSE
]
candidates <- candidates[order(candidates$padj, -abs(candidates$log2FoldChange)),,drop=FALSE]
GENE <- candidates$gene_name[1]
cat("Selected gene:",GENE,"\n")
write.csv(candidates,file.path(output_dir,"gene_candidates.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
```

## Gene-specific RNA box plot

Normalized RNA counts are shown for the **matched RNA samples**; the methylation panel uses methylation samples. These are not assumed to be identical cohorts.

```{r gene-rna-box, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
gene_ids <- de_results$gene_id[de_results$gene_name==GENE]
# If several Ensembl IDs have same gene name, use the selected result's gene ID.
gene_id <- candidates$gene_id[1]
stopifnot(gene_id %in% rownames(dds))
normalized <- counts(dds,normalized=TRUE)
plot_rna <- data.frame(group=matched_meta$group,
                       normalized_count=as.numeric(normalized[gene_id,]))
p2 <- ggplot(plot_rna,aes(group,log2(normalized_count+1),fill=group))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape=NA,alpha=.65)+
  geom_jitter(width=.14,height=0,alpha=.45,size=1)+
  theme_bw()+theme(legend.position="none")+
  labs(title=paste(GENE,"RNA expression"),x="Specimen group",y="log2(normalized RNA count + 1)")
print(p2)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"gene_rna_boxplot.png"),p2,width=7,height=5,dpi=180)
```

## Gene-specific CpG methylation bar plot

Each bar shows the **mean beta value of one CpG probe**, separately by group. Error bars show standard errors; sites are not assumed to be promoters or independent biological replicates.

```{r gene-methylation-bar, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
probe_ids <- limma_table$probe_id[!is.na(limma_table$gene_name) & limma_table$gene_name==GENE]
probe_ids <- intersect(probe_ids,rownames(beta))
stopifnot(length(probe_ids)>0)
# Cap at 25 most significant sites for legibility; report this selection explicitly.
ranked <- limma_table[!is.na(limma_table$gene_name) & limma_table$gene_name==GENE,,drop=FALSE]
ranked <- ranked[order(ranked$adj.P.Val),,drop=FALSE]
probe_ids <- head(intersect(ranked$probe_id,rownames(beta)),25)
bar_data <- do.call(rbind,lapply(probe_ids,function(id) {
  do.call(rbind,lapply(levels(grp),function(g) {
    vals <- beta[id,grp==g]
    vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
    data.frame(probe=id,group=g,mean_beta=mean(vals),se=if(length(vals)>1) sd(vals)/sqrt(length(vals)) else NA_real_,n=length(vals))
  }))
}))
bar_data$probe <- factor(bar_data$probe,levels=probe_ids)
p3 <- ggplot(bar_data,aes(probe,mean_beta,fill=group))+
  geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=.8),width=.75)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=pmax(0,mean_beta-se),ymax=pmin(1,mean_beta+se)),
                position=position_dodge(width=.8),width=.22,na.rm=TRUE)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1))+theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=60,hjust=1))+
  labs(title=paste(GENE,"CpG methylation (up to 25 CpGs)"),x="CpG probe",y="Mean beta value",fill="Specimen group")
print(p3)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir,"gene_methylation_barplot.png"),p3,width=10,height=5,dpi=180)
write.csv(bar_data,file.path(output_dir,"gene_cpg_summary.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
```

### Part 2 interpretation (automatically populated after execution)

```{r part2-interpretation, results='asis'}
gene_row <- candidates[1,,drop=FALSE]
cat(sprintf("The selected candidate **%s** has a metastatic-versus-primary RNA log2 fold change of **%.2f** (BH-adjusted p = %.3g) and at least one associated CpG with a positive metastatic-minus-primary methylation M-value difference meeting the specified thresholds. ",GENE,gene_row$log2FoldChange,gene_row$padj))
cat("The box plot compares normalized RNA abundance in the matched RNA samples, whereas the CpG bar plot displays site-specific mean beta values in the methylation cohort; the two panels need not include identical patients. ")
cat("This pattern is compatible with an inverse methylation-expression association but does not demonstrate that methylation represses this gene, because annotated CpGs may lie outside its promoter and other regulatory mechanisms may contribute. ")
cat("The groups represent specimen types rather than confirmed lifetime metastatic versus non-metastatic patient histories, and differences in sampling, cohort composition, and tumor purity limit causal interpretation.\n")
```
